excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, curly black hair, African ethnicity, goatee. Wears a purple tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jeans and white sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Pneumatic Scribing Fine Matrix from a Horned Dinosaur Skull

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_5 works at his laboratory workbench under focused task lamps, carefully steering a vibrating pneumatic air-scribe tool along a heavy block of grey dark organic mudstone matrix. The precise work removes the fine rock layers to expose the unique, strongly down-curved nasal horn of an Einiosaurus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
